svg.aria-label: Row one: C4 + E4, a major third of 4 semitones, becomes C4 + F4, a perfect fourth of 5 semitones. The lower voice C4 stayed; the upper voice moved from E4 to F4. Row two: C4 + F4 becomes B3 + F4, a diminished fifth of 6 semitones. The upper voice F4 stayed; the lower voice moved from C4 to B3.
svg.title: What stayed, what changed

g.text: Which voice stayed, which one changed
Changed: upper voice, E4 to F4
Changed: lower voice, C4 to B3
How to read this graphic: Each row has three parts: the start pair, what stayed and what
changed, and the end pair. The colour bar on each pair names that pair, not either
voice. Read left to right, then check that the voice that stayed has the same note on
